# LootDrop Docs

> Agent-readable documentation pack for LootDrop, a Discord-first reward-claim system powered by Bitrefill fulfillment.

## Core docs

- [PRD](./PRD.md): Full product requirements document.
- [Status](./STATUS.md): Implementation to-do list and current task board.
- [Resources](./RESOURCES.md): Official source links and market references.
- [Agent Index](./AGENT_INDEX.md): Chunk map and task pickup guide.
- [Agent Skill](./agents/SKILL.md): Behavioral instructions for agents using LootDrop tools.
